invariants.text: A book cannot be loaned to a member if the member's membership_status is 'inactive'.
A book's availability_status must be either 'available' or 'borrowed'.
A loan record must have a book_id that corresponds to an existing book in the Book table.
A loan record must have a loan_date and a return_date, with the return_date being on or after the loan_date.
A loan record must have a member_id that corresponds to an existing member in the Member table.
A member's membership_status must be either 'active' or 'inactive'.
Book.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each member can only be associated with one loan record at a time.
Loan.book_id must reference an existing Book.id
Loan.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.member_id must reference an existing Member.id
Member.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The total number of books currently borrowed must not exceed the total number of books in the library.
When a book is loaned out, its availability_status must be updated to 'borrowed'.
When a loan is returned, the book's availability_status must be updated to 'available'.
